sentences.text: This Court directs the respondent authorities as well as the District Administration of Charaideo and Sivasagar to take effective steps so that the instant writ petition can be disposed of at the earliest.

3. On the next date, the respondent authorities shall appraise this Court as to why the petitioner would not be entitled to the return of 5524 bighas 1 katha 2 lechas of land as well as also to the compensation in respect to 2152 bighas 2 kathas 1 lecha of land which were acquired on 13.09.2004.
4. This Court further directs the said respondent authorities to compute the entitlement of the petitioner and place it before this Court on the next date without fail.
